articles.title: Chameleon Amethyst
articles.summary: Deep purple-magenta fine weave that flips pink and violet as the light moves, like crushed velvet with glitter. Reads as a dark plum-purple car with a fine mottled facet shimmer; magenta and indigo cells blur into a two-tone purple speckle.
articles.what: Purple to pink to magenta color-shift like a turning amethyst crystal in sunlight Up close: Packed irregular crystal cells, about 10-25px across, like cracked stained glass or amethyst facets. Each cell is flat magenta-plum or indigo-violet, divided by thin pale lilac seams, with soft pink streaks bridging across some cells. From a distance: Reads as a dark plum-purple car with a fine mottled facet shimmer; magenta and indigo cells blur into a two-tone purple speckle. Measured spec (average): metal 72, roughness 118, coat 108. Shine: satin. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: body, hero panel, sides.
Fits: show car, gt / sports car, open wheel.
how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "Chameleon Amethyst" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Body, hood and roof: the fine facets work everywhere
Sides and quarters show the colour flip best
White or silver numbers with a dark outline read; purple or pink numbers vanish.
Solid stripes in silver, white or black: crisp lines on a fine facet ground
Pairs well with: black, chrome, silver, white.
pitfalls: Not a woven velvet: it is a crystal cell mosaic with seam lines, no weave
Not a smooth colour-shift: it flips between two flat colours cell by cell
Avoid: small numbers over the busy weave, another colour-shift finish beside it.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 72 (pearl-level metal), roughness 118 (satin or eggshell), clearcoat 108 (satin or weak clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal and roughness and clearcoat vary by 20 or more across the surface.
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: small numbers over the busy weave, another colour-shift finish beside it.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: solid stripes in silver, white or black: crisp lines on a fine facet ground; number plate or solid blocks: cells are too busy to read through
Patterns to avoid: hex, mesh, camo: competes with the cell structure; flake or glitter: already sparkling
Spec overlays that work: gloss clearcoat lift: glassier crystal look; avoid more metallic flake spec: hides the cell seams
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.

articles.title: Chameleon Obsidian
articles.summary: Near-black stealth flake, flat and dark, revealing faint purple and blue only at sharp angles. Reads as black with a faint bronze web, like dark cracked volcanic glass; the seams give a warm brown-gold net over a dark navy-black, no purple until the angle changes.
